description: MBAS is the official postgraduate student association representing MBA and business students committed to leadership, collaboration and meaningful industry engagement. We exist to shorten the distance between business education and professional practice by creating intentional spaces where postgraduate talent and industry connect with clarity and purpose. Our work is guided by three core pillars: 1) Awareness: We cultivate self-leadership, critical thinking and emotional intelligence as foundations for responsible leadership. 2) Access We prepare students to navigate complexity, uncertainty and evolving global markets with confidence and agility. 3) Adaptability We connect academic insight with real-world expectations, ensuring students and industry engage with mutual understanding. MBAS is not just a student body. It is a platform for growth, dialogue and contribution.

description: Hi and Welcome to the Mechatronics Student Association of RMIT! Mechatronics is an engineering discipline that encompasses robotics, electrical, electronics and mechanical engineering systems. This relatively new multidisciplinary field of engineering allows students to implement and integrate different physics or technologies for the purposes solving complex problems. This student run club is all about creating a community of Mechatronics engineers and enthusiasts, where we can share ideas, knowledge and connections to industry.
